name: Visa Visiteur (passive income / retirement)

value.note: passive income at least equal to SMIC, consular practice

requirements.blocker_text: This requires passive income (pensions, investments, savings) of at least the SMIC level, assessed by consular practice.
requirements.fix_path: Increase passive income or savings to the required level.

requirements.blocker_text: This does not permit any employed or self-employed work in France.

evidence_required.document: Proof of passive income or savings

sources.title: France-Visas — Visa de long séjour visiteur

notes: SOURCING CAVEAT flagged honestly, same class of caveat as Italy's Elective Residency route: France's Visa Visiteur has no single codified statutory minimum income figure the way Portugal's D7 (RMMG-pegged) or Spain's NLV (IPREM-pegged) do — consular practice commonly references the SMIC level as a benchmark, but this is discretionary rather than a hard legal figure. Encoded here as a formula referencing SMIC for consistency with the dataset's pattern, but flagged as consular-practice-based rather than statutorily fixed, distinct from the truly codified formula thresholds elsewhere in this file (e.g. fr_talent_salarie_qualifie's arrêté-fixed figure). family_can_work is explicitly false since dependants on this route inherit the same no-work restriction as the principal applicant — a genuine difference from every other family_can_work:true route in this dataset, worth flagging since it's easy to assume family members always get work rights by default.
